career_overview.short_description: Build reliable ways to collect, prepare and move data. Start with small local pipelines before exploring production-scale services.
responsibilities: Assess goals and constraints relevant to data engineer work
Apply appropriate tools and methods to a bounded task
representative_work: A repeatable local data pipeline with checks and a short readme.

roadmap.title: Data Engineer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor and browser. Most tasks use free software or simulation; specialist equipment, accounts and costs are flagged for review when applicable.
roadmap.final_outcome: A repeatable local data pipeline with checks and a short readme.
